card.thesis: Round 42, family 'breakout' on the taxable trading book (persona: Creator C (creator-c)). Every arm in this family shares the exit 'close crosses_below ema(20)' and the fixed brackets (stop 0.12, no take-profit, 150-day hold cap, 3 slots at 0.25 each); the ONLY thing that varies within the family is the entry expression. the family's persona (Creator C / creator-c) pre-registered that a genuine range breakout confirms by advancing 0.25 x the range height before it can be trusted, and that failed breakouts stall before reaching it; he pre-registered losses on gaps and in chop (PERSONA-DISCUSSION-2026-09-09.md section 3). His 1.0x-range profit target and 'within 5 days' clock are NOT expressible in this engine's DSL and are not part of this test -- see ROUND-42-PLAN.md section 6. This is the family's CONTROL: the plain level-crossing entry with no confirmation structure. Every treatment in this family is reported as arm-minus-THIS-control on median exposure-adjusted excess, never against SPY and never against the other family's control. Pre-registered 2026-09-09, before any measurement. Nothing here is promotable -- the `trading` purpose is exempt from PROTOCOL.md section 6 promotion by the r21 amendment; this is a measurement study, report only. Not investment advice. See strategy-program/ROUND-42-PLAN.md.
card.falsification: Baseline against which this family's treatments are measured. Honest prior: the null (rounds 17/18/34/38/39/40 put form, exit, rotation and confirmation conjuncts all inside the 21.2pp floor). Pre-registered predictions: (1) q25 takes fewer trades and enters later than the breakout control, giving back early upside in strong trends (bull-2024, recent) while avoiding false starts in chop (chop-2015, chop-2011). (2) the sign of arm-minus-control flips by regime -- named failure regime: gapping markets where the 0.25 confirmation is crossed in a single overnight gap then reverses, and sideways/choppy markets where 0.25 arrives too late to matter -- both named by the persona. -- so any single-window read is unsafe and only the eight-window median is interpreted. (3) An arm that fails the 5-of-8 regime gate and is unranked has been switched off, which is not the same finding as 'the confirmation did not help' -- the two must not be conflated. Decision rule: earns something only if arm-minus-own-control median adjusted excess exceeds 21.2pp AND survives BH q<0.10 over the field of 5 cells.
